g.text: RoatheRank3Convo3 begins.
Evaluate expressions on HellStory

Me atormenta día y noche. Esta persistente sensación de que no sólo te confié mis secretos más profundos, sino que traicionaste esa confianza y me lo quitaste todo, y ahora ni siquiera recuerdo por qué...
Estamos avanzando a buen ritmo para eliminar estos bloqueos de mi mente. Albrecht me dejó fatal al inyectarme ese suero.
Tu progreso para ayudarme a recuperar la memoria es insuficiente. Si deseas cumplir tu promesa, espero que continúes tu trabajo en Descendia.
No has avanzado en Descendia para desenterrar mis recuerdos. Si quieres que cumpla mi promesa, tendrás que esforzarte por cumplir la tuya.
false
Check boolean RoatheResetForgiven
No parecen nada agradables.
No parecen nada agradables. ¿Seguro que debemos continuar?
[Fin]
Honestamente, he tenido algunas dificultades... Sigo muriendo sin importar cuánto lo intente.
Yo no recibo órdenes tuyas, Roathe.
He tenido cosas que hacer. Me encargaré de ello.
No sólo te he perdonado por haberme quitado esos recuerdos...
true
No sólo estoy empezando a perdonarte por haberme quitado esos recuerdos...
false
No. No lo son. ¿Qué esperabas del "Diablo de Tau", recuerdos de una tarde soleada en el parque, recostado sobre una manta y comiendo uvas en una bandeja?
No sabré qué me arrebató hasta que lo recupere todo. ¡Claro que debemos seguir! Esos recuerdos son míos, Viajero. Forman quién soy, quién era. Son la esencia misma de mi ser.
Chat ends.
Update boolean RoatheStrugglebus
No, claro que no. Y lo que hagas con tu día no es asunto mío. Sólo digo que si quieres que ese mayordomo flacucho suba esas escaleras, tienes trabajo que hacer.
Asegúrate de hacerlo. No me importa lo que hagas con tu día. Sólo digo que si quieres que ese mayordomo flacucho suba esas escaleras, tienes trabajo que hacer.
Pero empiezo a desear volver a confiar en ti. ¡Otra vez! Sabiendo perfectamente lo que has hecho. ¡Sabiendo que podrías traicionarme una vez más!
Pobre Usurpador mío, temo que lo que encontraremos enterrado en los anales de mi mente no será más que sangre, vísceras y fracaso.
Por lo que he podido saber de los demás respecto a tu estancia en Duviri, tú también sufriste un destino similar, ¿no es así?
Sólo escucho historias de ti venciendo a Narmer. Derrotando hordas de soldados grineer. Derrotando oleadas de murmullos a cada paso. ¿Y aun así he logrado confundirte?
Si a ti no te importa, a mí tampoco. Tengo mis propios asuntos que atender.
Si a ti no te importa, a mí tampoco. Tengo mis propios asuntos que atender.
But I find myself sitting in that crypt and I stand from that chair and I think to myself "I wonder if Drifter is about and if they wish to speak."
Tú pilotas esta nave. Si quieres seguir navegando hacia el agujero negro, ve a toda velocidad.
Entonces, ¿seguro que deseas continuar?
Somos personas muy diferentes, Roathe.
Lo era. Recuerdo y apatía. Todavía no puedo recordar... fragmentos enteros de tiempo.
+20 Chemistry
Chat ends.
+10 Chemistry

How utterly pathetic is that? How low have I been brought? Me?! An Orokin?! Roathe! The Devil of Tau! So restless, so intellectually starved, so desperate for any kind of stimulation that I am here, speaking with you!
+10 Chemistry

I will not know what he took from me until I have it all back. Of course we should keep going! Those memories are mine, Drifter. They make up who I am, who I was. They are they very fabric of my being.
That may be, but it was hardly the point I was making. Which you are avoiding having to concede. Very well. If, in theory, you had lost memories - would you seek to regain them if you could?
If you had the opportunity to regain your lost memories, would you?
Assuming that you are not lying to me? I admit that is rather flattering. Adorable. Extremly sad. But flattering.
Chat ends.
I look forward to our conversations, whether you do or not.
I'll try not to take that personally.
Or, you just enjoy talking to me?
[Fin]
Well said, Drifter. I will not know the magnitude of what was taken from me until I have it all back. Those memories make up who I am, who I was. They are they very fabric of my being.
I think it's better to know than to not know, but... we have to be prepared for it.
Sometimes I think things should stay buried for a reason.
It's yours. It's time for us to go get it. How bad could it be? You're an Orokin, you've done worse things, certainly.
Chat ends.
Then I am so terribly glad I was not rendered unto a drooling idiot when you muddled about in my skull with a fork.
Perhaps you should. You were the one who muddled about in my skull with a fork, after all.
Perhaps I would, if I did not know you had muddled about in my skull with a fork.
Chat ends.
Prepared, precisely, how? Do you believe I will collapse like some feeble house of cards once I learn the terrible truth of some grotesque war crime?
Are we not then doomed to repeat our previous mistakes? Never learning, never evolving, forever living in blissful ignorance of our former selves?
+10 Chemistry
Check boolean RoatheResetForgiven
Believe me, I can imagine every possible thing I could have done to the Sentients, Orokin, or any combination thereof and there is little that would render me shocked or horrified.
Hm. I may have just made a case against my own argument for most people, I realize.
Hear, hear! I will hardly collapse like some feeble house of cards once I learn the terrible truth of some grotesque war crime.

I said I forgave you. And I am attempting to adhere to that which I promised you. It is simply that words do not sometimes make a thing true. And saying one forgives someone is very nice in theory but sometimes emotions have a hard time following fact.
true
Really, this is all quite irritating. I want to converse with you. But I also want to throttle you for having befouled my mind.
false
Add 1 to Thermostat
Add -1 to Thermostat
Add -2 to Thermostat
I understand. It's a hard thing to accept, and you might want to, but can't.
So you... don't forgive me?
You're going to just have to accept what happened and move on, Roathe.
Do you think you can ever forgive me?
I can remember enough to know that I could ask for "forgiveness" at the altar of the Luminaries for the next two thousand years and have it never granted.
I would prefer to learn all the facts myself and judge the situation from there.
I can imagine every possible thing I could have done to the Sentients, Orokin, or any combination thereof and there is little that would render me shocked or horrified.
I am trying my damnable and level best, Usurper. For there is something about you that has captured my attention. You are fascinating. And that is a rare thing in my world.
Mmhm.
Update boolean RoatheResetForgiven
No, what is waiting for me at the bottom of my mind does not scare me. I merely wish to reclaim that which was wrongfully taken from me.
No, what is waiting for me at the bottom of my mind does not scare me. I merely wish to reclaim that which was wrongfully taken from me.
So be patient with me, if you can, while I try to reconcile all this.
Chat ends.
+10 Chemistry
As you said. It is time for us to retake that which is mine.
I will.
I'm the one who should be asking for patience from you, Roathe. Not the other way around.
But I appreciate the concern, nonetheless.
Chat ends.
How kind of you.
+20 Chemistry
Chat ends.
+5 Chemistry
That recognition is appreciated.
Chat ends.
